literature.overlap: A monotone map composed with a predictive CDF is a direct precedent. The paper fits an isotonic recalibrator and recommends held-out calibration or Kfold training. Calibration alone does not establish sharpness or native-unit CRPS improvement. This work prevents presenting CDF composition as a new mechanism.

The inspected estimation uses logarithmic scores. Monotone CDF transport with an identity fallback therefore has direct prior art.
